fact: RRA's July 2023 presentation states a national Rwanda Automated Local Government Tax Management (LGT) system was adopted in 2015 for property tax, with property registration, online declaration and payment, audit and enforcement modules, real-time integration with the Land Information System and NIDA, lists of filers, payers and non-payers, and property tax at about 30% of local government collections.
title: Information Technology System for Property Tax Administration in Rwanda
publisher: Rwanda Revenue Authority (Addis Tax Initiative presentation)
